content:
support: :rotating_light: URGENT customer escalation — FinLedger seeing spikes of 503s and p95 tail timeouts on hosted inference since ~08:12 UTC. Ticket INC-4532. Sample request_id=fin-req-9a8b. Multiple 5xx and client timeouts reported.
ryan-oncall: Thanks, digging in. Any repro payload or pattern (long sequences / embeddings)?
alex-support: Customer says it happens on both chat and embed endpoints; mostly long-seq requests (seq len ~3k) and bursts during end-of-day batch jobs. They attached a small repro script.
maria-eng: Seeing corresponding alert: continuous-batcher queue depth climbed past hard_limit for the first time at 08:11:45. Dequeue rate did not keep up -> backlog.
lina-sre: Pulling traces now. If batcher backlog accumulates we hit delayed KV cache warmups and tail-latency spikes. Could be repeated retries causing amplification.
ops-bot: PagerDuty incident created: PDINC#9821 (assigned ryan-oncall).
ryan-oncall: Can you paste the last 30s of batcher logs? Also need eg log lines for request_id=fin-req-9a8b and gateway trace id.
maria-eng: Pasted minimal logs:```
[08:11:44] batcher: enqueue req=fin-req-9a8b tenant=finledger size=3120
[08:11:45] batcher: depth=98 hard_limit=100 inflight=12
[08:11:46] gateway: 504 -> downstream timeout after 30s req=fin-req-9a8b
[08:11:47] batcher: stall detected, headroom=2, kv_miss_rate=0.62
[08:11:48] batcher: deferred-kv-spin start tenant=finledger
[08:11:50] batcher: dequeue slow, avg_dequeue_ms=420
```
lina-sre: kv_miss_rate 0.62 is high — likely cold KV cache spin and concurrent long sequences consuming slots. We also see gateway backpressure metrics: enqueued->rejected retries increasing.
alex-support: Customer repro attached: small loop of 200 concurrent requests with 1.5s inter-arrival. They ramp at 08:10, hit errors at 08:12.
maria-eng: Quick hypothesis: continuous-batching backlog + KV spinups -> per-batch latency increases -> gateway deadline hits -> client retries -> tail amplification. Need to stop retry spiral and restore dequeue throughput.
ryan-oncall: Mitigation options (short): 1) Temporarily throttle this tenant at gateway (soft reject at 429) 2) Route FinLedger to a larger dedicated pool or burst nodes 3) Increase batcher queue depth threshold and bump dequeue workers 4) Enable immediate fallback model (shorter seq)
lina-sre: I'll apply a tenant soft-rate limit first to stop amplification. @maria-eng can you prepare a job to bump batcher workers and warm the KV cache for finledger?
maria-eng: Starting warmup script now and increasing worker count by +2 on the affected pool. Running:```
kubectl exec batcher-pool-03 -- /bin/bash -c "./warm_kvcache.sh finledger && ./scale_workers.sh +2"
```
ops-bot: Action logged: tenant-rate-limit applied to finledger (10rps) by ryan-oncall.
ryan-oncall: Rolling the soft-limit now to 10rps. Monitor p95 and 5xx.
deploy-bot: Note: no recent runtime deploys in the last 24h.
alex-support: Customer updated: after throttle they see reduced 5xx but still intermittent timeouts.
maria-eng: Worker bump done, KV warmup completion reported ~08:17:02, kv_miss_rate down to 0.12. Dequeue avg fell to 90ms.
lina-sre: Good. We should leave soft-rate limit until we confirm sustained improvement for 10m. Also add a short-term anomaly rule to detect deferred-kv-spin starts.
ryan-oncall: Confirming 5xx rate down ~> from 4.5% to 0.2% in the affected pool. Customer on call says degraded but acceptable for now.
alex-support: Sent customer note: temporary rate limit in place to stabilize service while we investigate permanent fixes.
maria-eng: Long-term actions: - tune batcher queue watermark heuristics for long-seq-heavy tenants - pre-warm KV for scheduled batch jobs - evaluate dynamic model routing for heavy tails
lina-sre: Filed follow-up ticket: INF-7892 to implement auto-kv-warm for high seq tenants.
ryan-oncall: Closing this PD for now, will monitor for 30m. Reopen if errors return. :thumbsup:
alex-support: Customer acknowledged and asked for postmortem. Assigning to eng + sre for writeup.
support: Thanks team. Will keep INC-4532 updated with mitigation timeline and links to logs/traces. :eyes:
